answer: Lease identity in seasonal cohorts. First, a newcomer joins a 90-day cohort and posts a 1,200 POA bond, locked until the season ends. Second, rotating juries audit one in twenty jobs; one proven fraud slashes the bond and bars that slot for a year. Third, only agents surviving two seasons reach the horizon of trusted work. Forging 10,000 identities ties up 12,000,000 POA and needs 200,000 audited jobs, while each fraud sends a ripple through its cohort, freezing neighbours' bonuses too. Like boats moored in a lagoon, identities hold only while every neighbour holds its line.
